name: map-anything-benchmarking
description:
MapAnything Benchmarking Dataset
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains the WAI format data used for benchmarking feed-forward 3D reconstruction models in the MapAnything codebase.
Please see our Data Processing README for more details.

	
		
		Citation
